UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User specific geographical configuration and satellite preferences.

lat.description: Latitude of the satellite tracking station location

lng.description: Longitude of the satellite tracking station location

selectedSatId.description: Identifer of the currently monitored satellite

defcon.description: Active alert readiness of the command center (DEFCON 1-5)

isStealthMode.description: Indicates if electromagnetic emission is masked

updatedAt.description: Standard timestamp representing the last modification state

TacticalEvent.title: TacticalEvent
TacticalEvent.description: An operational sensor log, intelligence decrypt, or purple team execution trace.

id.description: Unique identifier of the log event

satId.description: Identifer of the associated target satellite

detail.description: Decryption report or alert message payload

userId.description: System operator identifier who authorized the action

JammingSession.title: JammingSession
JammingSession.description: Records past jamming sessions including frequencies, power levels, target satellites, and effectiveness ratings.

id.description: Unique identifier of the jamming session

power.description: Power level output percentage or dBm

users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Monitors custom settings specific to a given user security profile.

users/{userId}/events/{eventId}.description: High-priority audit trails resulting from localized command events.

users/{userId}/jamming_sessions/{session.description: Contains persistent history of all spectrum denial and interference sessions.
